info.title: Climate Rapid Evaluation Framework
info.description:
API for querying the results from the Climate Rapid Evaluation Framework (Climate REF).
This is used to back the [Climate REF Explorer](https://dashboard.climate-ref.org) web application.

This API is a work in progress and will likely change in the future without warning.
We are interested in your feedback on how you would like to use this API.
This will help us prioritize features, and be aware of any API consumers before we make any changes.

Contact [Jared Lewis](mailto:jared.lewis@climate-resource.com) or
[file an issue on GitHub](https://github.com/Climate-REF/ref-app/issues),
if you have any questions or feedback.

get.description:
Get all the diagnostic values for a given diagnostic (both scalar and series)

- `value_type`: Type of metric values - 'scalar', 'series', or 'all' (required)
- `format`: Return format - 'json' (default) or 'csv'
- `offset`: Number of items to skip (default 0)
- `limit`: Maximum number of items to return (default 50, max 500)
- `mip_era`: Restrict to the groups of one era, so outlier detection and pagination
  see only the values the caller is charting.
  Groups that use no model data, such as observation-only ones, are kept.

Values come from the promoted diagnostic version, and retracted executions are left out.

get.description:
Get execution statistics for the dashboard.

Execution groups are counted at the promoted version of each diagnostic,
by the outcome of their latest execution, leaving out retracted executions.
Metric values, datasets and files are counted as stored, whatever their version or retraction.

List the most recently updated execution groups

Only groups at the promoted version of their diagnostic are returned,
and groups whose latest execution is retracted are left out.

Supports filtering by:
- diagnostic_name_contains (case-insensitive substring of the diagnostic slug)
- provider_name_contains (case-insensitive substring of the provider slug)
- provider_slug and diagnostic_slug (exact slugs)
- dirty
- successful (filters by latest execution success)
- failure_reason (filters by why the latest execution failed, e.g. `system_error`)
- source_id (the latest execution ran against a dataset of this model)
- mip_era (the group draws on this era)

Each execution's `outputs` are null unless `include_outputs` is set, because the file lists
make up most of the response. Fetch one group's files from `/executions/{group_id}`.

AFTCollectionFilterControl.title: AFTCollectionFilterControl
AFTCollectionFilterControl.description: A user-facing filter control (e.g. a dropdown) that overrides an other_filters key.

CMECMetric.title: CMECMetric
CMECMetric.description:
CMEC diagnostic bundle object

Contains the diagnostics calculated during a diagnostic execution, in a standardised format.

DiagnosticCatalogEntry.title: DiagnosticCatalogEntry
DiagnosticCatalogEntry.description:
Summary information about a diagnostic, without whether it has metric values.

Checking for metric values is the slow part of listing diagnostics,
so the catalog leaves it to `DiagnosticValueFlags`.

A diagnostic is a specific metric or set of metrics calculated by a provider.
Each diagnostic is associated may be associated with one CMIP Assessment Fast Track (AFT) diagnostics.

DiagnosticRuns.title: DiagnosticRuns
DiagnosticRuns.description: How one diagnostic went for one model.

DiagnosticSummary.title: DiagnosticSummary
DiagnosticSummary.description:
Summary information about a diagnostic.

A diagnostic is a specific metric or set of metrics calculated by a provider.
Each diagnostic is associated may be associated with one CMIP Assessment Fast Track (AFT) diagnostics.

DiagnosticValueFlags.title: DiagnosticValueFlags
DiagnosticValueFlags.description: Which kinds of metric values a diagnostic has

is_outlier.title: Is Outlier
is_outlier.description:
Whether the model falls outside the ensemble's inter-quartile fences.

Uses `OutlierPolicy` which is the defaults for the values list.

EnsembleComparison.title: EnsembleComparison
EnsembleComparison.description: One metric, comparing a single model against the rest of the ensemble.

EnsembleStatistics.title: EnsembleStatistics
EnsembleStatistics.description: The spread of one metric across every model that reported it.

ExecutionResourceSummary.title: ExecutionResourceSummary
ExecutionResourceSummary.description:
Roll-up of the resource usage recorded across a set of executions.

Only executions that recorded a wall time are counted.
CPU time and peak memory are optional, so they may be missing even when wall time is present.

success_rate_percentage.title: Success Rate Percentage
success_rate_percentage.description: Share of the groups whose latest execution succeeded, as a percentage (0-100).

ExecutionStats.title: ExecutionStats
ExecutionStats.description: Statistics for execution groups and their success rates.

FailedRun.title: FailedRun
FailedRun.description: An execution group whose latest execution did not succeed.

GroupCounts.title: GroupCounts
GroupCounts.description:
How many execution groups are running, failed, succeeded or not started.

Each group is counted once, by the outcome of its latest execution,
so `successful + failed + running + not_started == total`.
`dirty` overlaps the others.

MetricDimensions.title: MetricDimensions
MetricDimensions.description:
CMEC diagnostic bundle DIMENSIONS object

This describes the order of the dimensions and their possible values.
The order of the dimensions matter as that determines how the executions are nested.

MetricValueType.title: MetricValueType
MetricValueType.description: Type of metric values to query.

ModelDetail.title: ModelDetail
ModelDetail.description: Everything the model page needs about a single source_id.

ModelSummary.title: ModelSummary
ModelSummary.description: One row of the model index: a source_id and how its runs went.

ProviderSummary.title: ProviderSummary
ProviderSummary.description:
Summary information about a Metric Provider.

The diagnostic provider is the framework that was used to generate a set of metrics.

RefDiagnosticLink.title: RefDiagnosticLink
RefDiagnosticLink.description: Link to a specific diagnostic calculated by a provider.

description.title: Description
description.description: Description of how this dataset is used in the diagnostic

type.title: Type
type.description:
Role of this reference dataset:
- 'primary': Main reference dataset for the diagnostic
- 'secondary': Additional reference for comparison or validation
- 'comparison': Used for comparative analysis

ReferenceDatasetLink.title: ReferenceDatasetLink
ReferenceDatasetLink.description:
Link to a reference dataset used by a diagnostic.

Reference datasets are observational or reanalysis datasets that diagnostics
compare model outputs against. They can be classified by their role in the analysis.

ResultOutputType.title: ResultOutputType
ResultOutputType.description:
Types of supported outputs

These map to the categories of output in the CMEC output bundle

success_rate_percentage.title: Success Rate Percentage
success_rate_percentage.description: Successful groups as a percentage of the total, rounded to one decimal place.

RunCounts.title: RunCounts
RunCounts.description:
Execution groups classified by the outcome of their latest execution.

A group that has never run names no model, so it is absent rather than counted.

ScalarValue.title: ScalarValue
ScalarValue.description:
A flattened representation of a scalar diagnostic value

This includes the dimensions and the value of the diagnostic

SeriesValue.title: SeriesValue
SeriesValue.description:
A flattened representation of a series diagnostic value

This includes the dimensions, values array, index array, and index name
